result:
Done.

**Root cause:** `quiesce`'s recursion guard in `variants/bug01/engine.inc` compared the *absolute* `searchPly` against the literal `3` instead of `MAXPLY`, so at level 2 only one capture ply was resolved (the recapture stayed behind the horizon) and at level 3+ none was — a capture at the horizon was scored as free.

**Files touched**
- `variants/bug01/engine.inc:1436-1442` — `cp 3` → `cp MAXPLY`, plus a comment. One byte in the binary (offset 7500 = `0x9D4B`).
- `variants/bug01/quiesce_test.py` — new regression test (10 harness cases, ~4 s).
- `variants/bug01/Makefile` — `test:` target now runs that test.
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` — new, at the workspace root.

**Gate status**
- Reported symptom gone — **pass**. Mirror position d2 → `f8f7` / `Eval 0`; second position d2 → `c6d5` / `-24`; free-queen control → `e6d5` / `953`. All exactly the values the report attributes to a correct build.
- `cd variants/bug01 && make test` — **pass**, 6/6 checks, 27 s.
- New test — **pass**. 10/10 on the fixed build, 9/10 fail on the buggy build (the control passes by design); a full `make test` on a from-scratch build of the buggy source aborts at the new step, so the gate would have caught the bug as filed.
- `characterisation/characterise.py --tap variants/bug01/chess.tap --harness harness` — **pass**, 57 ok / 0 failed / 0 errors. Before the fix it was 56 ok / 1 failed (`se_recapture`).
- Review round — **clean**. One synchronous round, verdict "NO DEFECT IN THE FIX", which closes the gate (cap was 3).

**Knowingly left open**
- Restoring quiescence unmasks a pre-existing weakness: the clock is only checked *between* iterative-deepening iterations, so one search can blow the budget. Measured ~3–5× slower on Kiwipete, and in the promotion race `8/PPPPk3/8/8/8/8/4Kppp/8 b - - 0 1` a single search burns the whole 5:00 clock (flag-fall). I verified this is not specific to my constant — `cp 8`, a different value that also fixes the bug, flag-falls identically while `cp 3` does not — so it belongs to any build with working quiescence, i.e. to pristine. Fixing it is an engine change beyond this bug and would move recorded characterisation values.
- The constant is not uniquely pinned by behaviour: `cp 8` and `cp 12` also give 57/57 and pass the new test. The identification of `MAXPLY` rests on it being an otherwise-unreferenced constant, being exactly the per-ply frame capacity, and reproducing the report's expected values exactly.
- Reviewer advisories 4–7 (two test-tightness points, a stale `tt.inc` header comment, two pre-existing unrelated hazards) — recorded in `FIX_NOTES.md` §6, not resolved.
